description:
Write Go, understand the language and prepare for interviews on iPhone and iPad. GopherForge combines an on-device compiler and editor with a practical learning library. Build, run, test, vet and format with bundled Go 1.27.1, even offline once project sources are present.

BUILD AND EXPLORE
• Edit Go and go.mod with highlighting, completion and keyboard shortcuts.
• Open diagnostics at source lines; inspect output and individual test results.
• Create projects from templates or import public GitHub repositories, Files folders and exported archives.
• Organize projects with favorites, tags and file-name search. Navigate nested files with a collapsible sidebar.
• Prepare compatible pure-Go dependencies using the Go proxy and checksum database. Rebuild with downloaded sources offline.
• Inspect setup failures, retry, or clear downloaded packages while keeping your source.
• Explore local HTML/CSS/JavaScript previews, Go-generated PNGs, concurrency timelines and rule-based idiom guidance.

LEARN GO WITH WORKED EXAMPLES
• Follow 186 teaching lessons and 22 prediction challenges in 23 units: declarations, collections, interfaces, errors, generics, modules, concurrency, runtime and standard library.
• Study 139 readings with code, explanations, primary references, diagrams and understanding checks. Expand highlighted examples to full screen.
• Compare architecture approaches by use case and tradeoff. Explore clean code, all 23 classic design patterns and six concurrent Go patterns.
• Practice JSON v2 contracts, absent versus null values, strict input policies, WaitGroup.Go, synctest and errgroup cancellation.
• Go beyond syntax with Bash, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB and Redis. Learn SQL pool lifetimes, row cleanup, transaction ownership, isolation and safe retries.
• Use Codex, Claude Code and Cursor in your own Go environment: repository instructions, API checks, tests and trust boundaries.
• Return with Continue. Completion, compiler evidence, interview self-assessment and study places persist locally across normal relaunches.
• Match concepts in Review and revisit mistakes with three-choice questions and explanations. Self-marked readings and compiler-verified exercises are identified separately.

PREPARE FOR GO INTERVIEWS
• Work through 92 guides across 12 topics and four difficulty levels, from Junior to Staff / expert.
• Explain an answer, compare reasoning, identify a trap, solve a worked exercise and try a follow-up.
• Cover language/runtime, concurrency, architecture, HTTP/SQL, testing, modules, databases, containers and coding agents.
• Step through twelve algorithm labs with 36 scenarios. Trace search, windows, graphs, heaps and dynamic programming, plus topological sorting, union-find, LRU eviction and merging intervals. Inspect state, Go code and complexity.

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICE
Native layouts adapt to iPhone, iPad and supported iPhone Duo postures. Collapse Files, choose theme and text size, and use touch or external keyboards. Extra scroll room keeps final lines reachable. Keep the screen awake during builds and downloads, or protect access with supported Face ID/passcode locking.

PRIVACY AND COMPATIBILITY
One paid download. No subscription, app account, advertising trackers or native analytics SDKs. Projects and progress stay local; a chosen Files/iCloud library follows your provider. Web and app progress are separate.

Go runs in a bounded WebAssembly/WASI sandbox: no guest networking, cgo or arbitrary shell. Module archives have resource budgets, including 4,000 files per ZIP. Terminal commands are app-supported. Database, deployment and coding-agent lessons teach a separate native environment; they do not install services or connect the app to AI providers. Imports/downloads need a connection. WebKit previews may load project-linked remote resources.

reviewNotes:
GopherForge 1.2.0 build 45. No account or demo credentials required. Release automatically after approval.

Learn > Course: 23 units, 186 teaching lessons and 22 prediction challenges (208 items total). New Around Go: SQL services and Around Go: coding agents units are near the end of the course, with five and four readings. Standard library adds three JSON v2 readings. Concurrency adds WaitGroup.Go, synctest and errgroup. Each has examples, visual steps, references and an understanding check.

Learn > Interview: 92 guides, 12 interactive algorithm labs, 36 scenarios. Open Algorithm demonstrations and choose Topological sort, Union-find, LRU cache or Merge intervals; step through state changes. Go implementations and complexity are included.

Persistence: open the agent workflow reading, mark complete, relaunch, then tap Continue. Course and Interview have separate local bookmarks. Stable IDs and storage formats are preserved. Self-reported reading completion differs from compiler evidence.

New opaque dark teal gopher icon. Learning screenshots are refreshed from the real build. Website guide describes actual capabilities and limits.

Compiler remains bundled Go 1.27.1 in bounded WASI. No guest networking, cgo or arbitrary shell added. Database, deployment and agent material is educational for an external native environment, not a service integration. No subscription, IAP, account, analytics SDK or advertising added. Web and native progress are separate.
